title: By them, the man with my voice and my eyes and a ghostwoman with ashes on her breath
html_source: Stephen has inherited characteristics which make him like his father and inherited the experience of unavoidable death – his mother who appears to him in rosy images. Stephen’s father, Simon, is alive literally, and alive in Stephen’s inherited physical features.
